name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Measured adaptive playback. Android and other handheld apps no longer receive a blanket 1080p/13 Mbps conversion: compatible originals can stream at full quality, while necessary conversions use the client's limits and measured link capacity. Federation Auto now retains high-speed capacity, handles sub-10 Mbps links, and caps high-bitrate remuxes instead of disabling its limit above 50 Mbps. Peer speed tests combine three bounded steady-state media-route samples using the median, reject truncated bodies, and retain conservative behavior on failure. Includes everything in 0.0.202.
